definitions.explanation: To reproduce text or content by writing or typing it. Often used for copying from a source.
To capture an image using a camera. To record visually.

examples.japanese: {黒板|こくばん}の{字|じ}をノートに{写|うつ}す。
examples.english: Copy the writing on the blackboard into your notebook.
examples.notes: に marks the destination of the copy

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}の{宿題|しゅくだい}を{写|うつ}してはいけません。
examples.english: You must not copy your friend's homework.

examples.japanese: {景色|けしき}を{写|うつ}しました。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pair: {写|うつ}る (intransitive, to be photographed/reflected). Pattern: Xを{写|うつ}す (copy/photograph X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {写|うつ}している = 'is copying/photographing.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・ノートに{写|うつ}す (copy into a notebook)
・{写真|しゃしん}を{写|うつ}す (take a photograph—though {撮|と}る is more common)
・{文章|ぶんしょう}を{写|うつ}す (copy text)
・そのまま{写|うつ}す (copy exactly as is)

HOMOPHONES: Several verbs are pronounced 'うつす':
・{写|うつ}す: to copy, photograph
・{移|うつ}す: to move/transfer something
・{映|うつ}す: to project (image), reflect

The kanji helps distinguish meaning. {写|うつ}す relates to reproduction/capture of images or text.
